text: まるくって　ふわふわで　ぬいぐるみ　みたいな　ポケモン！

structure.jp: ぬいぐるみ　みたいな　ポケモン！
structure.en: a Pokémon like a stuffed toy!

patterns.name: 〜くて
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い to くて means 'is this, and...'; くって is a bouncy spoken form of it. まるくって = 'round and'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいな
patterns.span: ぬいぐるみ　みたいな　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: みたいな between two things means the second is like the first. ぬいぐるみ みたいな ポケモン = 'a Pokémon like a stuffed toy'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the 'and' form of だ, joining one description to the next. ふわふわで = 'is fluffy and'.
